synthetic.question: A juggler can juggle 36 balls. One quarter of the balls are tennis balls, and one third of the tennis balls are pink. How many pink tennis balls are there?
synthetic.answer:

Pink tennis balls:9*1/3=<<9*1/3=3>>3 balls
